main_text.head: DVOBVS EXIMIIS IESV CHRISTI IN ECCLESIA sancta Tigurina seruis, summa tum pietate tum doctrina praestantibus viris, fratribus & symmistis observandis Theodorus Beza M. P.

p.i: Ergo superstes ego defleda in funera fratrum Miseram miser vitam traham? Et quos morte sequi morientes nō datur vna, Moriar in illis millies? Sic me quantumuis annis, Lauatere, priore Tam morte praeteris cita? Sic me ide, tecu in vitam quae protulit anus, Gualthere Magne deseris? Gualthere in vita vita mihi charior ipsa, Gualthere, Beza alter mihi. Ah, quanti, qualesq; viri? tenebris sepulti, Ah quanta mundi Lumina?

page.notes: The running head at top is faint and partly illegible; given as DEDICATORIA. Several lines of the verse are rendered with the printed long-s forms normalised. Line "Ah, quanti, qualesq; viri?" is as printed.
